item.title: It's in the Fiber.
item.description: A spruce tree takes anywhere from ten to twenty years of growth before it can be harvested. I don’t know why I know that. Of all the facts I’ve collected over the years, that one’s been on my mind most recently. Ten to twenty years. I think I read it once in a pamphlet at a rest stop, or maybe a teacher told me, in that voice teachers use when they want you to find the natural world…

item.title: The Man Who Erased Himself
item.description: Full Research Document So, there’s this mystery man on YouTube, Nexpo.
